- Address: 1, rue Gaston Boissier - 75724 Paris Cedex 15

- Manufacturer: PRECIA SA BP 106, FRA 07001 PRIVAS CEDEX

- Recommendation: R76/2006 → canonical R76, edition 2006
- Date issued: October 28, 2019
- Member State: FRANCE
- page_total: 0 (annex consists of 0 pages) — the schema says page_total for the certificate document. Hmm, "comprend 0 page(s)" refers to the annex. The page_total field in the certificate is likely the annex page count. I'll set page_total: 0.

Accuracy classes: III, IIII. In OIML R76, class IIII is sometimes written as IIII (i.e., 4 × 10^-... actually class I, II, III, IIII). So accuracy_classes: ["III", "IIII"].

Recommendation id: "R76", edition: 2006. Scheme: "A"? The recommendation object has scheme field per schema. Yes: scheme.

project_number: not present. oiml_issuer_id: not present explicitly. There's "Référence LNE - 35102 rév. n°1" — that's a LNE internal reference, not OIML issuer ID. I could omit.

test_reports: not named explicitly. Omit.

revision_history: not present.

footnotes: none.

type_designations: ["P1411-B"]. The type is "Indicateur type P1411-B" — Indicator type P1411-B.

model_family: only one model, so omit.

characteristics: type_level: accuracy class III or IIII — this is a list of classes, could be recorded as accuracy_class: "III or IIII"? Better to put in recommendation.accuracy_classes and maybe also type_level characteristic accuracy_class with value "III, IIII" — hmm. Rules say don't fabricate. I'll add a type_level characteristic `accuracy_class` with value "III" or... Actually classes are multiple: III or IIII. I could record as value string "III or IIII"? The schema says value can be string. But cleaner: recommendation.accuracy_classes: ["III", "IIII"]. And maybe omit characteristics entirely or include accuracy_class with string value. I'll include type_level: accuracy_class with value "III or IIII"? Hmm, that might be odd. Let me just do it as two... The schema doesn't support multi-values in type_level except string. I'll use value: ["III", "IIII"]? Value must be number | {min,max} | string. A list isn't allowed. I could emit two entries? attribute repeated seems wrong. Simplest: value string "III, IIII"? Or omit and rely on recommendation. I think including it is fine: {"accuracy_class": {"value": "III or IIII", "unit_symbol": null, "unit_id": null}}. Hmm. Alternatively value "III; IIII". I'll go with "III or IIII".

Address lines: LNE address: "1, rue Gaston Boissier", "75724 Paris Cedex 15". Applicant PRECIA SA: "BP 106", "07001 Privas Cedex", "France". Manufacturer: "BP 106", "07001 Privas Cedex", "France".
